title: Forward claim scoreboard: every hypothesis, kept on the books
headline_insight: Across 259 claim families the nulls-or-worse (134) slightly outnumber the 121 verified, an honest ratio of 1.107 nulls per confirm.
what_it_means: The system tracks every sport-by-hypothesis family it has ever tested and keeps the failures on the record. Of 259 distinct families, 121 currently sit verified, 99 came back null, 28 were not testable, and 7 were retracted. A grader that only ever confirmed would not be credible; this one publishes more misses than hits.
how_to_read: Each row is one sport x hypothesis family, its status is the most recent verdict in the ledger, and 5 families flipped verdict across reruns (e.g. NBA three-in-four fatigue went NULL then CONFIRMED).
why_it_matters: Keeping nulls, not-testables, and retractions in the same ledger as the confirms is the credibility mechanism, it shows the self-grading is real rather than curated.
caveat: Current status is just the last ledger entry, and many rows predate run_ts stamping (run_ts is null), so ordering within a family can be undated.
